title: The smell of it
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The frame shop's smell: mat board, glue, cedar dust, the owner's coffee. It's on Wood's coat at the college. The tech notices. The tech names all four. The tech has worked in one.

panels.composition: The print shop. The TECH sniffing once as WOOD comes in. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a print technician sniffing once as a young man in an overcoat enters with a small dog, black and white, no words
a young man smelling his own coat sleeve, surprised, black and white, no words

balloons.text: Worked in one. Coos Bay. Two years.

image.prompt: a print technician loading paper, not looking up, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copier's light. Wood looking at the tech's hands on the paper tray. Straight. He pulled eventually. The strip doesn't ask when.

image.prompt: a photocopier's green light sweeping while a young man looks at a technician's steady hands on a paper tray, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The tech pushed, once, in Coos Bay. 'Pull, don't push' from two mouths now.
